title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) — Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
hint: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis — Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
hint: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. title: CVE-2026-127222: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST…
hint: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root. CVSS 8.7 HIGH.…
